entries.en: Hmmm... two seconds....
entries.ro: Hmmm... două secunde....

entries.en: Give me one moment...
entries.ro: Dă-mi un moment...

entries.en: You're in luck. There's a restaurant upstairs.
entries.ro: Ai noroc. E un restaurant la etaj.

entries.en: I don't know how long I here, but as you Americans say – "I'm starving."
entries.ro: Habar n-am cât am stat aici, dar, cum ziceți voi, americanii, «mor de foame».

entries.en: Did you turn on the lights?
entries.ro: Ai aprins luminile?

entries.en: You're in luck. There's a restaurant upstairs.
entries.en_m: Well, you're in luck. There's a restaurant upstairs.
entries.ro: Ai noroc. E un restaurant la etaj.
entries.ro_m: Păi, ai noroc. E un restaurant la etaj.

entries.en: Any idea what's in the corpo code-case?
entries.ro: Ai vreo idee ce e în code-case-ul corpo?

entries.en: I know! The whole time... those aromas! What torture!
entries.ro: Știu! Tot timpul... aromele alea! Ce tortură!

entries.en: You must visit me some day. I'll show you a few netrunning tricks.
entries.ro: Treci pe la mine cândva. Îți arăt câteva trucuri de netrunning.

entries.en: Hm. Maybe it's not such a good idea after all.
entries.en_m: Huh. Maybe it's not such a good idea after all.
entries.ro: Hm. Poate nu e chiar ideea cea mai bună, până la urmă.

entries.en: Hah... You a fast learner.
entries.ro: Hah... Înveți repede.

entries.en: You young people ask too many questions. See for youself.
entries.ro: Voi, tinerii, puneți prea multe întrebări. Verifică singură.
entries.ro_m: Voi, tinerii, puneți prea multe întrebări. Verifică singur.

entries.en: Wasn't it me who just saved your ass?
entries.ro: Nu eu tocmai ți-am salvat pielea?

entries.en: We never stop learning hard lesson. But you don't have to do everything alone.
entries.ro: Mereu mai înveți câte ceva din greu. Dar nu trebuie să faci totul singură.
entries.ro_m: Mereu mai înveți câte ceva din greu. Dar nu trebuie să faci totul singur.

entries.en: Thanks, I'll think about it.
entries.ro: Mulțumesc, mă gândesc.

entries.en: [Slot shard]
entries.ro: [Introdu shard-ul]

entries.en: Wake up!
entries.ro: Trezește-te!

entries.en: Wake up!
entries.ro: Trezește-te!

entries.en: Hey... you all right?
entries.ro: Hei... ești bine?

entries.en: Uh, wait... I.. I can't...
entries.ro: Ăă, stai... Nu... nu pot...

entries.en: Had a look through your messages.
entries.ro: M-am uitat prin mesajele tale.

entries.en: Did you switch on the lights?
entries.ro: Ai aprins luminile?

entries.en: Yes. I was ready for a game of "twice for yes, once for now," but you beat me to it.
entries.ro: Da. Eram gata de o rundă de «de două ori da, o dată nu», dar m-ai luat-o înainte.

entries.en: Had a peek at your messages. Looks like this Spectral_Kid was right, huh?
entries.ro: Am dat un ochi peste mesajele tale. Deci Spectral_Kid avea dreptate, nu?

entries.en: Hmm... I get stuck after all. When he find out, he'll become completely insufferable.
entries.ro: Hmm... până la urmă tot mă blochez. Când o afla, devine insuportabil de tot.

entries.en: That why you didn't ask him for help? Case of a fragile ego?
entries.ro: De-aia nu i-ai cerut ajutor? Ego fragil, ce?

entries.en: No, but because I was trapped in the subnet, the lights were as far as I could go.
entries.ro: Nu, dar fiindcă eram prins în subnet, luminile au fost tot ce am putut face.

entries.en: You're probably wondering who sent me.
entries.ro: Probabil te întrebi cine m-a trimis.

entries.en: What's in the code-case?
entries.ro: Ce e în code-case?

entries.en: Fine work you did.
entries.ro: Ai făcut treabă bună.

entries.en: So, you're probably wondering who sent me.
entries.en_m: So, you're prob'ly wonderin' who sent me.
entries.ro: Deci, probabil te întrebi cine m-a trimis.

entries.en: So you were conscious?
entries.ro: Deci erai conștientă?

entries.en: Partially. More like in deep hibernation.
entries.ro: Parțial. Mai degrabă în hibernare profundă.

entries.en: Wakako... She always find an excuse to drag me to her place for dinner.
entries.ro: Wakako... Mereu își găsește o scuză ca să mă tragă la ea acasă la cină.

entries.en: You all right?
entries.ro: Ești bine?
